# codefixture

A document that cites `E_KNOWN` and the removed `E_DOC_GONE`.
Emphasis wraps _E_EM_GONE_ and __E_STRONG_GONE__, an escape spells
E\_ESCAPED\_GONE, and _W_KNOWN_*_ and W\_KNOWN\_\* cite a registered family.
A plural reads E_PLURAL_GONEs, a suffix E_BOGUS2x, and E_KNOWNs is registered;
E_Known and W_Foo_bar are words. Emphasis left open, _raised as E_OPEN_GONE_,
closes on no family, and the unbalanced _E_KNOWN_ONE__ is registered.
Two capitals then lowercase read E_ABs, an underscore then lowercase E_ODD_bar,
and neither E__DOUBLE nor a bare E_* is a code.
